summary: Snippets Marketplace + Find/Replace + TypeScript run all tested end-to-end. Backend: 33/33 pytest cases pass — 21 existing regressions (health, projects, files, run for py/js/html/css, timeout, chat stream+history+clear) plus 12 new tests covering POST/GET/detail/star/toggle/starred/delete-forbidden/delete-cascade/search/language-filter and a real TS annotation ('const g: number = 42; console.log(g);') via tsx. Frontend: Editor find bar opens, 'Hello' → count '1/1', Replace All to 'Bonjour' rewrites editor text (verified). Snippets screen renders 2 seeded snippets, search 'fib' narrows to 1, filter=python narrows to 1, Publish modal creates a new snippet visible at top of list, star toggle updates counter icon. Two frontend issues found: (1) Snippet detail modal footer 'Insert at Cursor' button renders at y≈1635px in a 844px viewport — button is unreachable to a real mobile user; (2) as a result, Insert-at-Cursor into editor could not be visually verified end-to-end (editor content unchanged after JS click bypass). Deprecated warning still present: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated'.

ui_bugs.issue: Detail sheet footer 'Insert at Cursor' button is positioned at y≈1635px inside a 844px viewport (measured via getBoundingClientRect), making it unreachable to a real user on 390x844. The modal container's flex:1/justifyContent:flex-end + sheet maxHeight:85% does not constrain height correctly on react-native-web; ScrollView content likely expands past the Modal. Reference: /app/frontend/app/snippets.tsx:325-373 (detailBackdrop/detailSheet styles).

Could not confirm snippet code is inserted into the editor on return. After router.replace('/'), editor still showed the seeded file content unchanged (print('Hello from Syntax IDE')). This may be a side-effect of the JS-click bypass (Pressable onPress not firing for programmatic .click()), but combined with the unreachable button (issue above) this flow is effectively broken on mobile until the modal is fixed.

issues: publish-lang chips row scrolls horizontally; the 'Python' chip is off-screen at mobile width (390px) and requires horizontal scroll to reach. Consider showing selected chip first or wrapping to two rows.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — carried over from iteration 1, still present.

action_items: Fix SnippetDetailModal layout so the 'Insert at Cursor' footer is visible within the viewport on mobile. Suggested: give the outer Modal container an explicit height (e.g., style={{ height: '100%' }} on the backdrop View), or wrap the sheet in a fixed-height container. On react-native-web, `flex:1` inside a Modal often does not constrain to viewport — set position:'absolute', inset:0 on backdrop.

After modal fix, re-verify Insert-at-Cursor: snippet.code should appear in the editor at the cursor position via the AsyncStorage 'syntax.pending_insert' + useFocusEffect path in /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:230-245.
Optional: replace deprecated `pointerEvents` prop with `style.pointerEvents` to silence the console warning.

rca_of_issue: Snippet detail modal footer unreachable: React-Native-Web renders <Modal> as a portal but the immediate container inside styles.detailBackdrop uses flex:1 which on web resolves to auto (no parent height constraint), so justifyContent:flex-end aligns the sheet after all content flow — pushing the sheet's absolute position to ~2x viewport height. Fix: pin the backdrop to viewport using {position:'absolute', top:0, left:0, right:0, bottom:0} OR {height:'100vh'} on web, so justifyContent:flex-end has a bounded axis. Reproduce: open /snippets, tap any snippet card, observe 'Insert at Cursor' button offscreen (getBoundingClientRect().y ≈ 1635 with viewport 844).
